lines.text: Every community starts the same way.
A few people. And a reason to get together.
A book club. A rope circle. A Sunday picnic. A basement gig.
Then come the platforms. Fees on every ticket. Your people, turned into data.

lines.tag: calm, quietly confident, a small smile
lines.text: Revel is different.
It's open source. Anyone can read it, run it, and make it better.
Buyers pay the ticket price. No fee on top.
The money goes straight to the organizer.
No ads. No trackers. And your data is never, ever sold.
Some rooms need a little more care.
Like a rope workshop in Vienna, built on trust.
So before anyone gets a ticket, they answer a few questions.
About experience, the consent guidelines, and why they want to come.
Then a real person reads every answer, and makes the call.

lines.tag: warm, joyful, a little breathless smile
lines.text: And then, you're in.
Everyone in the room chose to be there. And was welcomed with care.
Potlucks. Member pricing. Pay what you can. Waitlists. Check-in at the door. In six languages.
Revel.
The free, open-source event platform for communities, clubs and independent venues.
Let's revel.
